name: team_planning_set_reporting_line
description: Set who a person reports to in a scenario of a Team Planning plan: a manager (manager_id), an open manager position (manager_position_id), so a team whose manager is being hired reports to that seat, or neither for no manager. Never both, never the person themself, and never a line that would make a loop. Reporting lines are independent of units: placing someone never moves their line. Steps after the scenario, and its alternatives, inherit the line unless they set it again. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

manager_id.description: The person they report to. Give this or manager_position_id, or neither.

manager_position_id.description: A position the scenario has, for a manager being hired.
